title: Autonomous Car Learns To Powerslide Into Parking Spot
summary: A short IEEE Spectrum clip of Stanford's autonomous car Junior learning to powerslide into a parking spot. It shows several approaches to the maneuver.
why: Cited as a simple example of automated driving maneuvers beyond what human drivers can do.

quote.text: a new sport/hobby of semi-automated driving where you can perform maneuvers that are difficult or impossible for the best humans today.
